data.title: JOYY Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results: Total revenues record consistent increases, driven by sustained growth of three core businesses
data.description:
JOYY Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results: Total revenues record consistent increases, driven by sustained growth of three core businesses

JOYY Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results: Total revenues record consistent increases, driven by sustained growth of three core businesses

PR Newswire

SINGAPORE, Nov. 18, 2026

SINGAPORE, Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- JOYY Inc. (NASDAQ: JOYY) ("JOYY" or the "Company"), a leading global technology company, today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.

In the third quarter, JOYY maintained solid growth momentum. Total revenues reached US$624.6 million, up 15.6% year over year and 5.7% quarter over quarter. Social entertainment revenue was US$441.0 million, up 8.8% year over year. BIGO Ads, including both first-party and third-party businesses, generated US$145.7 million in revenue, up 39.6% year over year, with its third-party advertising business sustaining strong growth of 52.3% year over year. SHOPLINE revenue reached US$37.8 million, up 24.7% year over year. The contribution from non-livestreaming revenue further increased to 32.8% of total revenues this quarter, driven by the Company's multi-engine growth strategy.

JOYY's non-GAAP operating income reached US$46.6 million, up 14.6% year over year. Non-GAAP EBITDA reached US$55.7 million, up 10.1% year over year. Operating cash inflow for the quarter was US$102.2 million. As of September 30, 2026, JOYY held US$2.94 billion in net cash. Supported by the Company's strong cash flow generation and solid financial position, it continued to return capital to its shareholders for their long-term support through cash dividends and share repurchases. As of November 13, the Company has returned a total of US$536.0 million to shareholders this year.

Ms. Ting Li, Chairperson and Chief Executive Officer of JOYY, commented, "We have continued to execute our multi-engine growth strategy, strengthening our core Social Entertainment business while developing Ad Tech and Smart Commerce as two new growth engines. Following our investments and business model validation over the past few years, the results of this strategy are becoming increasingly evident in sustained topline expansion. Looking ahead to 2027, we believe JOYY will enter an important phase as we advance our multi-engine growth strategy and translate our progress into stronger operating results. With increasingly clear growth paths across our three businesses, we are confident in the Company's ability to sustain solid revenue growth in 2027. We also expect greater scale, a stronger earnings mix, and improved operating efficiency to drive further growth in operating profitability." 

Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights

  • Net revenues in the third quarter of 2026 were US$624.6 million, representing an increase of 15.6% from US$540.2 million in the third quarter of 2025 and an increase of 5.7% from US$590.8 million in the second quarter of 2026.
    - Social Entertainment revenue was US$441.0 million, representing an increase of 8.8% from US$405.5 million in the third quarter of 2025 and an increase of 4.3% from US$422.7 million in the second quarter of 2026.
    - BIGO Ads revenue was US$145.7 million, representing an increase of 39.6% from US$104.4 million in the third quarter of 2025 and an increase of 9.0% from US$133.7 million in the second quarter of 2026.
    - SHOPLINE revenue was US$37.8 million, representing an increase of 24.7% from US$30.3 million in the third quarter of 2025 and an increase of 10.0% from US$34.4 million in the second quarter of 2026.
  • Operating income was US$13.5 million.
  • Non-GAAP1 operating income was US$46.6 million, representing an increase of 14.6% from US$40.7 million in the third quarter of 2025.
  • Non-GAAP1 EBITDA was US$55.7 million, representing an increase of 10.1% from US$50.6 million in the third quarter of 2025.
  • Net cash as of September 30, 2026 was US$2940.5 million.
  • Net cash from operating activities was US$102.2 million.

Third Quarter 2026 Business Highlights

Social Entertainment Business

In the third quarter, Social Entertainment continued to deliver steady growth, with year-over-year growth momentum further accelerating. The Company's global average mobile MAUs reached 278.8 million, up 4.7% year over year. Livestreaming revenue reached US$419.8 million, up 8.1% year over year and 4.3% quarter over quarter. Driven by effective and refined operations, the number of core livestreaming paying users grew 8.1% year over year and 4.8% quarter over quarter.

Bigo Live, the Company's flagship product, continued its steady revenue growth, supported by ongoing improvements in content operations, its streamer ecosystem, and AI applications. In content operations, Bigo Live continued to build on its strengths as a global social platform to better cater to users' cross-regional content consumption and social interaction needs. Bigo Live further refined its cross-regional content distribution algorithms, expanded live translation coverage, and enhanced speech recognition in complex acoustic environments, making it easier for cross-language communication. These improvements drove continued growth in cross-regional gifting among users in developed markets. In terms of the streamer ecosystem, Bigo Live continued to invest in its community by refining growth and incentive mechanisms for new streamers. In particular, Bigo Live improved onboarding and guidance to help newly signed streamers successfully launch their first livestreams. These efforts contributed to a 4.7-percentage-point increase in the share of newly signed streamers completing their first livestream compared with the previous quarter, bolstering Bigo Live's high-quality content pipeline. Bigo Live continued to integrate AI into livestream interactions and virtual gifting, expanding its AI-generated interactive content and virtual gifts to create a more personalized experience for users. In September, the share of total virtual gift consumption attributable to AI-generated interactive virtual gifts increased further to 35.4%.

Furthermore, Bigo Live continued to deepen local community engagement and foster vibrant creator ecosystems. In the Middle East and North Africa, as an official content partner of the 2026 Esports World Cup, Bigo Live delivered an immersive viewing format that integrated tournament livestreams with interactive experiences. Across Southeast Asia, Bigo Live hosted multiple mid-year galas in local markets, supporting the growth of local creators and the sustainable development of its ecosystem. In North America, BIGO Academy combined online growth challenges with offline recognition, highlighting the vitality of its creator ecosystem and strong user engagement. In South America, Bigo Live held its inaugural offline event in Brazil and organized roadshows in Colombia and Peru, expanding public awareness of the platform and fostering a more vibrant and inclusive local creator ecosystem.

BIGO Ads Advertising Technology Business

In the third quarter, BIGO Ads continued to expand its global traffic network, diversify its advertiser verticals and demand mix, while improving its algorithms and ad delivery efficiency. As a result, BIGO Ads' revenue reached US$145.7 million, up 39.6% year over year and 9.0% quarter over quarter. Its third-party advertising business, BIGO Audience Network, grew 52.3% year over year and 9.2% quarter over quarter.

On the supply side, BIGO Ads continued to expand its global developer ecosystem and broaden the high-quality traffic coverage. In the third quarter, SDK traffic grew 55.6% year over year. In October, BIGO Ads SDK became generally available via Google AdMob™ Mediation as an in-app bidding partner. Developers can now seamlessly access the BIGO Ads SDK through Google AdMob Mediation and tap into massive demand from global premium advertisers. This integration creates new opportunities for BIGO Ads to expand its premium traffic supply and reach a broader range of app categories.

On the demand side, BIGO Ads continued to strengthen its presence in key verticals by expanding its local advertiser base and accumulating more advertiser conversion data. These insights helped further refine its algorithms and optimize ad delivery solutions across different web-based verticals. Web-based advertising demand continued to accelerate, growing by approximately 328% year over year and 30% quarter over quarter, becoming a key driver of BIGO Ads' growth this quarter. Meanwhile, in-app demand maintained healthy growth momentum.

On the technology side, BIGO Ads continued to enhance its data and AI-driven algorithm capabilities to improve the precision and efficiency of ad delivery. As its cross-channel attribution systems improved and advertiser conversion data accumulated, the platform further upgraded its model architecture to support multiple conversion objectives and types of traffic, improving algorithm accuracy and iteration efficiency. Meanwhile, BIGO Ads continued to refine its bidding strategies to better assess the value of each ad impression and match advertiser budgets with available inventory more effectively. These improvements helped advertisers meet their ROI targets while enhancing the efficiency of BIGO Ads' traffic acquisition and monetization.

SHOPLINE E-Commerce Business

In the third quarter, SHOPLINE continued to focus on acquiring high-quality brand merchants, strengthening its presence in key markets, and enhancing its omnichannel commerce infrastructure and value-added services. SHOPLINE's revenue reached US$37.8 million, up 24.7% year over year and 10.0% quarter over quarter.

In the cross-border business, SHOPLINE enhanced its service offerings and local support to help these merchants migrate to its platform, manage operations across markets, and process cross-border transactions more efficiently. In the third quarter, revenue from cross-border merchants maintained strong momentum, growing 77.8% year over year. To support the growing base of brand merchants, the Company continued to enhance SHOPLINE Payments with more local payment options, stronger multi-currency payment support, and improved transaction management. These enhancements helped merchants manage cross-border payments easily and efficiently.

In AI Commerce, SHOPLINE's strategy revolves around helping merchants capture demand from AI channels and improve their operational efficiency. As AI agents change how consumers discover and purchase products, SHOPLINE continued to strengthen its capabilities and expand integrations with the broader AI ecosystem. While volume from AI channels is still in an early stage, adoption is building quickly. In the third quarter, page views and order volume from AI channels grew nearly 500% and 550% year over year, respectively. Notably, AI is demonstrating distinct advantages in categories such as consumer electronics and furniture, where shoppers weigh multiple options before buying. In these categories, AI can better interpret consumer needs, recommend relevant products, and guide shoppers toward a purchase. SHOPLINE Omi, an AI-powered commerce assistant, has rolled out features spanning product management, customer segmentation, promotional events, guidance on platform features and settings, and detailed store performance analysis, bringing AI deeper into merchants' day-to-day workflows and improving operational efficiency.

  1. This press release includes certain non-GAAP financial measures as additional clarifying items to aid investors in further understanding the Company's performance and the impact that these items and events had on the financial results. The non-GAAP financial measures provided above should not be considered as a substitute for, or superior to, the measures of financial performance prepared in accordance with GAAP. For details of the non-GAAP measures, including the reconciliations of GAAP measures to non-GAAP measures, please refer to the press release titled "JOYY Reports Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results" issued by the Company on November 19, 2026.
  2. Google AdMob is a trademark or registered trademark of Google LLC.

data.title: From 2 to 8 Hours: HiTHIUM Showcases Full-Duration Portfolio and Sodium-Ion Solution at RE+ 2026
data.description:
From 2 to 8 Hours: HiTHIUM Showcases Full-Duration Portfolio and Sodium-Ion Solution at RE+ 2026

From 2 to 8 Hours: HiTHIUM Showcases Full-Duration Portfolio and Sodium-Ion Solution at RE+ 2026

PR Newswire

LAS VEGAS, Nov. 18, 2026

LAS VEGAS, Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- From November 17 to 19, 2026, HiTHIUM, a leading global energy storage technology company, showcased its integrated energy storage solutions and end-to-end delivery capabilities at RE+ 2026 in Las Vegas. Organized around storage duration, the exhibition featured solutions spanning 2 to 8 hours, highlighting HiTHIUM's lithium-sodium technology portfolio, grid integration capabilities, and applications for AI data centers and microgrids.

8-Hour LDES: Unlocking Greater Lifecycle Value

As renewable energy penetration increases across the United States, the duck curve is becoming more pronounced, particularly in solar-intensive markets such as California. Meanwhile, the rapid expansion of AI data centers and extreme weather events are driving greater demand for continuous power and grid resilience. These trends are strengthening the need for long-duration energy storage.

In response, HiTHIUM presented its ∞Power 6.9+MWh 8h solution, featuring a native 8-hour architecture in a standard 20-foot container and powered by its self-developed ∞Cell 1300+Ah battery cell. Designed for a 25-year service life, the system achieves a DC round-trip efficiency of at least 96%. Compared with a 5MWh configuration, it requires approximately one-quarter as many battery cells per GWh, 27% fewer containers, and 68% less peak auxiliary power, helping improve overall project economics.

Sodium-Ion Solutions: Broadening Technology Choices and Advancing Cost Competitiveness

Lithium resource concentration and price volatility are important considerations for U.S. customers. Sodium resources are more than 400 times as abundant as lithium and are more evenly distributed. As sodium-ion production scales, its cost is expected to decline toward parity with lithium-ion, expanding customers' technology choices.

HiTHIUM showcased its Next-Generation Sodium-Ion Energy Storage Solution ∞Power N4.0MWh, powered by its self-developed ∞Cell N785Ah sodium-ion battery cells. Designed for long-life energy storage applications, the solution features a cell cycle life of up to 20,000 cycles and a system design service life of 30 years. By advancing both lithium-ion and sodium-ion technologies, HiTHIUM is further expanding its energy storage technology portfolio and offering customers more options for diverse application scenarios.

Grid Integration: Strengthening Local Validation Capabilities

HiTHIUM also highlighted grid analysis and validation capabilities, including plant-level modelling, automated simulation, RMS and EMT benchmarking, hardware-in-the-loop verification and site measurement validation. Its SIT test platforms operate in Xiamen, Chongqing and Dallas; a European regional pre-commissioning platform is under construction in Spain and scheduled for completion in 2027.

Expanding into AIDC and Microgrid Applications

For AI data centers, HiTHIUM presented an integrated solution spanning battery containers, PCS, PPC, EMS and lifecycle services. Its portfolio includes LFP systems for durations above 2, 4 and 8 hours, as well as a sodium-ion option for durations above 2 hours.

For cold-chain warehousing, food processing and industrial parks, HiTHIUM's ∞Power 1022kWh liquid-cooled storage cabinet—integrated with PCS, on/off-grid switching and EMS—enables PV-storage coordination and critical-load backup. It stores surplus solar or off-peak power and discharges at peak to cut costs; during outages, it switches off-grid to prioritize refrigeration and other critical loads while dynamically managing remaining loads such as EV charging.

With integrated capabilities spanning product development, grid validation, and project delivery, HiTHIUM is committed to addressing the evolving needs of the North American market. Moving forward, the company will continue strengthening its local capabilities and delivering reliable, integrated energy storage solutions to support the region's energy transition.

data.title: 'I've been a stay-at-home mom': I'm 50 and have a chronic illness. My husband lost his job. Should he raid his 401(k)?
data.description:
By Quentin Fottrell

'Our financial and healthcare situation has become increasingly concerning'

"COBRA is too expensive. I also looked into Priority Health coverage and was quoted $1,400 per month, which is beyond what we can manage financially." (Photo subject is a model.)

Dear Quentin,

I am 50, and my husband recently lost his job. I have been a stay-at-home mom for many years and also live with a chronic illness that limits my ability to work full-time. I recently started working as a daycare aide at our local public school, but our financial and healthcare situation has become increasingly concerning.

I have several questions:

1. Health insurance and access to medical care

Unfortunately, my husband was not transparent with me about the circumstances surrounding his employment, so I wasn't given the opportunity to plan ahead for my healthcare needs. My health insurance was tied to his employment and, as a result, I was unable to renew my specialty medications or schedule an appointment with my neurologist.

COBRA is too expensive. I also looked into Priority Health coverage and was quoted $1,400 per month, which is beyond what we can manage. What other options should I explore? Are there affordable health insurance alternatives, marketplace plans, or assistance programs that could help someone in my situation?

2. My husband's 401(k) and retirement savings

My husband is considering withdrawing money from his 401(k). These funds are intended to support us during retirement. What is the best way to handle his 401(k)? Would rolling it over into an IRA or another retirement account be a better option than withdrawing the money? Are there ways to transfer or invest these funds without triggering unnecessary taxes?

3. My personal savings and retirement planning

I have $150,000 in a money-market account earning 3.1% interest. This money represents savings from my previous employment, along with funds I consistently set aside from our monthly household budget over the years. I want to make sure I am being responsible with this money and putting it to work for my future.

What would be the best way to manage these savings for retirement? Should I keep the money in a money-market account, consider CDs or high-yield savings accounts, or explore other investment options that could provide better long-term growth while protecting my principal? I need to make informed decisions and protect my financial future.

Feeling Insecure

Related: 'I have no financial safety net': I'm 66, rely on Social Security and have just $500 in savings. What hope do I have?

You can email The Moneyist with any financial and ethical questions at qfottrell@marketwatch.com. The Moneyist regrets he cannot reply to questions individually. Check out The Moneyist's private Facebook group.

He can apply for insurance outside the normal open-enrollment period from Nov. 1, 2026, through Jan. 15, 2027, on the ACA Marketplace.

Dear Insecure,

Your healthcare plan is an immediate priority, so sort that out ASAP.

Losing workplace health insurance qualifies your husband for a special enrollment period on healthcare.gov. He has a 60-day window after the loss of his coverage to pick a plan. The ACA Marketplace may ask for documents, including an employer or insurer notice, to verify when his coverage ends. The ACA Marketplace calculates his premium based on his age, location, household size and expected household income for the entire calendar year.

Importantly, he can apply outside the normal open-enrollment period, which runs from Nov. 1, 2026, through Jan. 15, 2027, on the ACA Marketplace. He may also qualify for an ACA subsidy. If he was earning $45,000 before being laid off and, assuming he doesn't have another job to go to, he will earn less for the remainder of the year; he will need to estimate his total income for 2026, which includes his salary up until the time he was laid off and unemployment benefits.

There is no asset test for most adults under 65 who qualify for the ACA Marketplace through the rules based on their modified adjusted gross income (MAGI). MAGI is calculated using adjusted gross income, taking certain adjustments or deductions into account. It's used to determine eligibility for certain tax deductions and credits, as well as certain government benefits and surcharges. The formula can change depending on what benefits you are applying for.

It's not so unusual to get sticker shock from COBRA's prices.

If your husband applies through the ACA Marketplace and his income appears low enough for Medicaid rather than Marketplace subsidies, the application should probably be referred to the relevant state program. Given that he has just lost his job and his income has dropped, tell him to check both state healthcare plans and ACA Marketplace plans. As you point out, it's not so unusual to get sticker shock from COBRA's prices.

COBRA can cost $800 a month for individual coverage and $2,300 for family coverage, depending on the plan. Again, he has 60 days to elect COBRA, and once he pays the required premiums, his coverage can be applied retroactively to when his employer coverage ended. To qualify for COBRA, the U.S. Labor Department says he must have been covered by his employer's group health plan, the plan must be subject to COBRA, and other qualifying conditions must be met.

Some Moneyist Facebook Group members weighed in on your questions. "Don't get distracted with things that don't matter," one wrote. "Rolling over your husband's 401(k) is not a priority. It can stay in his employer's custodian and roll over to a Schwab or Fidelity-type institution when things calm down. His focus needs to be 100% on getting a new job, not worrying about your retirement. You are nowhere near ready for retirement so employment is what matters."

Don't miss: 'It leaves me with a sour taste': My elderly mother gave our cousin $800 for a car repair. Should I be worried?

Retirement savings and planning

I understand why you and your husband might think withdrawing from your 401(k) could help, but it could have the opposite effect in the long run. I urge you to proceed cautiously. There's increasing evidence that, with the rising cost of living and stubbornly high interest rates, more Americans feel under pressure to dip into their retirement savings - sometimes as a short-term loan, which they may not be able to pay back.

If your husband does dip into his 401(k), he may be forced to pay a 10% penalty for withdrawing funds before 591/2 and, if that wasn't harsh enough, he will also be required to pay income tax on his early withdrawal. For example, if you need $50,000 to supplement your living expenses over the next 12 months, he may need to withdraw considerably more to account for taxes and potential penalties. The IRS has effectively made every effort to deter you from doing so.

There is a "rule of 55" for making unexpected or early withdrawals. If a person leaves or loses their job during or after the calendar year they turn 55, or age 50 for certain public-safety workers, they can make withdrawals from a 401(k) plan without having to pay that 10% penalty. Income taxes still apply, however, and the funds must remain in that employer's 401(k) rather than being rolled over to an IRA.

We are living in a "low fire, low hire" jobs environment.

Given your age, investing your $150,000 in a diversified stock-market portfolio could make more sense than a money-market account, high-yield savings account (HYSA) or CD. Keeping it in a money-market account (at a 3.1% interest rate) could give you around $203,500 over 10 years versus $222,000 in a HYSA or CD (at 4%), or $295,000 in a balanced portfolio (at 7%). The big caveat is that the stock market provides no guarantees.

There are no hard-and-fast rules, but many advisers recommend that someone around 50 consider an asset allocation of 60% to 80% equities and 20% to 40% fixed income (bonds and cash equivalents). However, your risk tolerance plays a big part in that. It would not be unusual to find someone who is invested in 90% or even, in some cases, 100% stocks at 50, given that they have another 15 years or more until they retire.

In the meantime, cut your costs and look into selling any valuables that could get you through this financial crunch. I trust your husband has applied for unemployment insurance and has pursued your health-insurance options before that 60-day window has closed. You will need patience. We are living in a "low fire, low hire" jobs environment. The average job search takes about three to six months, so be prepared for a hard slog.

Keep your cool and don't make any hasty decisions.

Related: My 93-year-old father changed his will at the 11th hour, leaving my brother his entire $500,000 estate. Can I challenge it?

'Our family is broken beyond repair': My brother took over my parents' finances. What can I do?

data.title: Beyond Static Estimates: How Cisco's Product Carbon Footprint Feature Tracks a Decarbonizing Grid
data.description:
NORTHAMPTON, MA / ACCESS Newswire / November 18, 2026 / by Lucy Nguyen

Cisco

Businesses are setting ambitious net-zero targets while facing increasing demands for transparent, verifiable data on their Scope 3 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. For many, this is where the carbon footprint of purchased products, like Cisco hardware, can become a critical piece of the sustainability puzzle.

The challenge is getting data that is usable in real workflows: by product, by year, and at the scale required for procurement, reporting, and target tracking. To address this challenge, we evolved our product carbon footprint (PCF) data to not only estimate the GHG emissions of a product over its life cycle, but to incorporate the impact of growing electricity grid decarbonization over time.

Why static PCFs are evolving

Michael King, senior leader of carbon accounting and analytics at Cisco, recognized that a static carbon footprint number often misses the significant decarbonization efforts happening across the supply chain or the ongoing shift to cleaner energy grids.

"Companies ask for product carbon data they can use in their own accounting that's aligned to their base year, reporting year, and net-zero timeline," says King. So, he developed a robust methodology that goes beyond traditional static calculations to dynamically adjust PCFs, reflecting real-world decarbonization.

For example, a product purchased today will have a lower carbon footprint than the same product purchased five years ago, even if the physical product is identical, due to the cleaner electricity powering its production.

Here's how Cisco is approaching dynamic PCFs:

  • Identify hotspots: We start by pinpointing the components within Cisco products that contribute most significantly to GHG emissions. These "hotspots" can include printed circuit boards, integrated circuits, and the energy used in testing and assembly.
  • Isolate electricity emissions: For these hotspots, we determine the portion of emissions directly attributable to electricity consumption during manufacturing (representing Scope 2 emissions of our suppliers).
  • Adjust dynamically: We then leverage reputable global energy grid data and projections from organizations like the International Energy Agency (IEA). This allows us to:
    • Backcast: Recalculate historical PCFs, showing how a product's footprint would have looked in past years as grids were more carbon intensive.
    • Forecast: Project future PCFs, illustrating the anticipated reductions as energy grids continue to decarbonize based on forecasted scenarios.

From disclosure to decision-making

Dynamic PCF data offers a powerful advantage. It allows companies to:

  • Track progress: Measure the reduction in their Scope 3 emissions over time, directly linked to their procurement of Cisco products.
  • Set realistic targets: Use projections to inform net-zero pathways and demonstrate tangible progress to stakeholders and regulators.
  • Make informed decisions: Understand the benefits of upgrading to newer Cisco hardware, which often incorporates further design and manufacturing efficiencies.

Fraunhofer, a leading German research institute, has critically reviewed our static PCF methodology to facilitate alignment with international standards, like ISO 14067. We plan to have them review our dynamic PCF calculation as well, providing third-party validation that ensures the accuracy and reliability of our data.

Built to scale

We're operationalizing this data so partners and customers can access it in the tools and workflows they're already using.

  • For partners: PCF data is available through Cisco's price list API for eligible products. Reach out to your Partner Account Manager to learn more.

data.description:
GUANGZHOU, China, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Fangzhou Inc. (“Fangzhou” or the “Company”) (HKEX: 06086), a leading provider of AI‑driven Internet healthcare solutions, announced a strategic partnership with Baiyunshan Pharmaceutical General Factory (“Baiyunshan Pharmaceutical”) at its 2026 Double 12 Partner Conference in Guangzhou, as the companies seek to expand AI-powered healthcare services and develop new digital marketing solutions.


Fangzhou and Baiyunshan Pharmaceutical Launch AI-Powered Chronic Disease Management Initiative

The conference brought together industry experts, pharmaceutical partners and healthcare professionals to explore opportunities in AI-powered digital marketing and full-lifecycle health management.

At the conference, Fangzhou presented the latest developments in its “AI + Chronic Disease Services” strategy. The Company has expanded AI applications across health monitoring, patient follow-up and health education, while upgrading its AI Health Manager, AI Medication Assistant and AI pre-consultation tools to further enhance services for patients and physicians.

“Digital transformation is not simply about upgrading individual tools, but about reshaping how healthcare services are delivered,” said Mr. Wang Haijiao, Executive Director and Chief Executive Officer of Fangzhou. “Our focus is on leveraging our medical resources and technology capabilities to deliver practical, high-quality care solutions for our users.”

Wang added that Fangzhou plans to work more closely with partners to develop integrated services covering online health assessments, one-on-one follow-up support, professional health guidance and prescription fulfillment.

Baiyunshan Pharmaceutical is an established Chinese drug manufacturer with businesses spanning antibiotics, reproductive health and traditional Chinese medicine, as well as development pipeline of innovative oncology treatments. The partnership will focus on developing a digital marketing ecosystem and exploring new business models by combining Fangzhou's AI-powered healthcare capabilities and broad service reach with Baiyunshan Pharmaceutical's product portfolio and industry expertise. Wang added that the companies hope to improve access to medical innovations while extending healthcare services across the patient lifecycle.

Kong Jian, Party Secretary and Chairman of Baiyunshan Pharmaceutical, said the two companies have built a strong foundation through more than a decade of collaboration. He described the new agreement as an opportunity to establish a model for AI-powered chronic disease services and jointly develop digital marketing capabilities that make quality healthcare more accessible.

Looking ahead, Fangzhou will continue strengthening its position as a “full-lifecycle personal health service partner,” expanding its AI-powered chronic disease services and working with pharmaceutical companies and other industry partners to improve healthcare accessibility and efficiency across China.

data.title: BOJ's Ueda Reaffirms Readiness to Keep Raising Rates
data.description:
By Megumi Fujikawa

TOKYO--Bank of Japan Gov. Kazuo Ueda again reiterated that he is prepared to tighten monetary policy further, reinforcing market views that another interest-rate hike could come as soon as December.

Speaking to a parliamentary committee on Thursday, Ueda said it is important to keep underlying consumer inflation anchored around 2% so that it doesn't overshoot the central bank's 2% target and hurt the economy.

"The bank will continue to raise the policy interest rate and adjust the degree of monetary accommodation, in response to developments in economic activity and prices as well as financial conditions," he said.

Ueda warned that one measure of underlying inflation--consumer prices excluding fresh food--is likely to accelerate clearly above 2% as firms pass on higher labor costs, oil remains expensive and the yen's weakness persists. Surging global demand related to the artificial-intelligence buildout adds another inflationary impulse.

In September, that gauge of underlying inflation accelerated to 2.1% year-on-year from August's 1.7%. Economists polled by data provider Quick expect October data due Friday to show a further rise to 2.3%.

The BOJ said last month that underlying inflation had reached its 2% target for the first time since the goal was introduced in 2013.

data.title: Powering Ahead: Sungrow Demonstrates Resilience and Innovation at RE+ 2026
data.description:
Powering Ahead: Sungrow Demonstrates Resilience and Innovation at RE+ 2026

Powering Ahead: Sungrow Demonstrates Resilience and Innovation at RE+ 2026

PR Newswire

LAS VEGAS, Nov. 18, 2026

LAS VEGAS, Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Sungrow, a globally leading PV inverter and energy storage system provider, showcased its latest energy technologies and solutions at RE+ 2026, addressing the evolving energy needs of the North American market. Highlights included the latest advancements in Safety of Utility-scale Energy Storage, Integrated Power Solutions for AI data centers, and an Enhanced Modular Inverter for utility-scale solar, and flexible energy storage solutions for commercial and industrial (C&I) applications.

PowerTitan 3.0: Advancing Large-Scale Energy Storage Safety

A major highlight at RE+ was the first public presentation of Sungrow PowerTitan 3.0 Large-Scale Fire Test (LSFT) video, offering attendees an inside look at its system-level safety validation.

In October 2026, PowerTitan 3.0 successfully completed a large-scale fire test. The test was conducted under the lead of UL Solutions, with Fire Risk Alliance (FRA) and Jensen Hughes (JH) present. It marks the industry's first large-scale fire test of a stacked-cell BESS featuring an integrated AC-block design, demonstrating Sungrow's continued commitment to advancing energy storage safety.

Beyond safety, PowerTitan 3.0 delivers high efficiency and rapid deployment for utility-scale energy storage applications. The system achieves up to 99.3% power conversion efficiency and 92% round-trip efficiency (RTE), helping minimize energy losses throughout the charge and discharge cycles.

Its stacked battery cell design helps reduce the risks of overheating and short circuits. Combined with self-monitoring capabilities, the system manages potential thermal risks with over 99% warning accuracy, supporting safer and more reliable operation.

Designed for rapid deployment, PowerTitan 3.0 features factory pre-assembly and pre-testing to reduce on-site installation and commissioning effort. A 1 GWh project can be grid-connected in as short as 12 days, helping accelerate project delivery and improve overall deployment efficiency.

Integrated Power Solutions for AI Data Centers

As AI data centers drive growing demand for reliable and high-efficiency power infrastructure, Sungrow presented its integrated power solutions featuring the EnerNeo Solid-State Transformer (SST) and a range of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) based power supply architectures for AI Data Centers application.

Sungrow offers EnerNeo Solid State Transformer (SST), designed to make power delivery simpler and more efficient. The modular design EnerNeo SST offers 1.5–6 MW power range and simplifies power delivery by converting medium-voltage AC directly into 800V DC. Complementing the SST, Sungrow presented three BESS architectures tailored to different data center power requirements: Grid-Forming (GFM) BESS, MV-UPS + BESS, and Dual-PCS + BESS. Built on different approaches to power management, these solutions support dynamic load smoothing, grid support, and power resilience. Together, they offer data center operators flexible options to address increasingly complex power challenges as AI infrastructure scales.

Optimized 4.8 MW Modular Inverter for Utility-Scale Solar

Sungrow also showcased its optimized 4.8 MW SG4800UD-MV-US modular inverter for the North American utility-scale solar market. Combining the advantages of central and string inverter technologies, the solution delivers 1.6 MW per unit in a flexible modular design, helping reduce balance-of-system (BOS) costs.

The split modular design enables inverter module replacement in under an hour, minimizing downtime and improving operational efficiency. Smart DC terminal temperature protection and a bottom pressure relief design further strengthen system safety. The inverter also features PV grid-forming and off-grid commissioning capabilities, supporting earlier commercial operation and helping improve project returns.

PowerStack 255CS: Supporting North America's Growing C&I Market

As Sungrow continues to expand its presence in the North American C&I energy storage market, the company showcased the PowerStack 255CS integrated energy storage system with built-in PCS.

The system delivers 257 kWh of capacity in a two-hour configuration. Designed for versatile applications, the PowerStack 255CS supports standalone energy storage, PV-plus-storage systems, EV charging integration, and microgrids. It also accommodates off-grid applications, providing a flexible energy solution for businesses seeking to enhance power reliability and maintain critical operations.

Powering North America's Energy Future

From AI data centers, utility-scale energy storage to solar power generation and C&I applications, Sungrow continues to develop technologies that address the increasingly diverse needs of the North American energy landscape.

Through its ongoing innovation in power conversion, energy storage, and grid-forming technologies, Sungrow remains committed to supporting North America's evolving energy infrastructure with efficient, reliable, and adaptable solutions.

About Sungrow

Sungrow, a global leader in renewable energy technology, has pioneered sustainable power solutions for over 29 years. As of June 2026, Sungrow has installed 1100 GW of power electronic converters worldwide. The Company is recognized as the world's most bankable PV inverter and energy storage company (BloombergNEF). Its innovations power clean energy projects across the globe, supported by a network of 520 service outlets guaranteeing excellent customer experience. At Sungrow, we're committed to bridging to a sustainable future through cutting-edge technology and unparalleled service. For more information, please visit: www.sungrowpower.com/en
